insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured options: INR 2 Lacs to INR 6 Crores (Sum Insured = Base Sum Insured + Super Reload + Super Credit (if applicable) + Cancer Booster (if applicable) etc.)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote:
Room Rent
Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Activ One MAX)
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actuals up to the Sum Insured with no room-category or per-day cap mentioned. This lets you choose any room without triggering room-rent linked deductions.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Pre-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 90 days before admission. This reduces out-of-pocket costs for consultations, tests, and medicines leading up to hospitalization.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (Claim Protect)
great.explanation: Non-payable consumables are covered as per all 4 lists in Annexure I under Claim Protect. This can significantly cut common hospital add-ons like gloves, masks, and procedure kits that are often excluded.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: A reload equal to the Base Sum Insured is available unlimited times during the policy year. This helps you handle multiple hospitalizations in the same year without exhausting cover after the first big claim.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote:
Super Credit (Increases Irrespective of Claim)
Under this Benefit... (“Super Credit”) will be applied/increased... irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table + Section C.11 Super Credit
great.explanation: Sum Insured can increase via Super Credit on renewal irrespective of claims in the previous policy year. This builds extra coverage over time even if you had a claim.

great.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Medical Expenses incurred during the Policy Period on Domiciliary Hospitalization...
great.explanation: Medical expenses for domiciliary hospitalization (treatment at home when hospitalization is required) are covered. This is useful when a hospital bed is unavailable or the patient cannot be moved.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses incurred... arising out of Hospitalization for a Bariatric Surgery... subject to the conditions... as per Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Hospitalization expenses for bariatric surgery are covered subject to the conditions in Section D.1.6. This can help manage high-cost obesity treatment when medical criteria are met.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Listed specified diseases/procedures are not covered until 24 months of continuous coverage is completed. This is a common market-standard waiting period for such conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days from the first policy start date, while accidents are covered immediately. This is standard and mainly affects early claims for non-accidental conditions.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Post-hospitalization medical expenses are covered for up to 180 days after discharge. This is in line with common plans, though some premium policies offer more than 180 days.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount... If the Insured Person takes treatment... other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 10% on each and every claim...
bad.reference: Section C.13.5 Preferred Provider Network (PPN) Discount
bad.explanation: A 10% co-pay applies on each and every claim if treatment is taken at a non-PPN hospital under the PPN Discount option. This can materially increase your out-of-pocket cost even when the claim is otherwise admissible.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
